incidents.title: Iran claims fresh strike on U.S. base as Hormuz shipping crisis deepens
incidents.description: Iran claimed a fresh drone strike against a U.S. military facility in Bahrain on Sunday, as mine incidents in the Strait of Hormuz and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia heightened regional tensions. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said six drones targeted an air-defense radar at Bahrain’s Riffa Air Base. Bahrain issued repeated security alerts, but ...
